verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's materials touch only the denial leg of the story. They offer a refund of attorney fees for qualifying applicants whose NIW is denied, and they candidly warn that no one can guarantee a USCIS decision. Nothing addresses running a company remotely while waiting or Canadian and other interim options, and the generic "we help you understand your options" line does not cover fallbacks. Missing for 10: guidance on operating the company remotely from abroad during processing, Canadian or other interim visa or relocation options, substantive post-denial next steps (appeal, motion to reopen, refiling), and any independent corroboration.
